_about: Public-domain Peter Mogila (Petro Mohyla, 1596-1647), metropolitan of Kiev, for the Word Hoard: The Orthodox Confession of the Catholic and Apostolic Eastern Church from the version of Peter Mogila, edited by J. J. Overbeck with a notice by J. N. W. B. Robertson (London: Thomas Baker, 1898), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 38 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mogila-orthodox-confession-1898: The Orthodox Confession of the Catholic and Apostolic Eastern Church, from the version of Peter Mogila, edited by J. J. Overbeck (London: Thomas Baker, 1898)

_excluded.mogila-other: The 1762 London printing: its title page names neither Mogila nor a translator, held for Adam's ruling with the anonymous title pages
